review.reason: The table’s main mappings are backed by the cited passages: 5G NR conformance test cases and FSW/SMW options, OTA receiver tests and SMW/FSW roles, mmWave frequency/bandwidth capabilities, and energy-saving measurement setups are all substantially supported. A couple of connecting claims are extrapolated, especially tying FSW directly to the Beamforming/Massive MIMO driver via [1] and treating frequency coverage/bandwidth as an explicitly stated measurable requirement, but these do not undermine the overall answer.
